### Step 1 — Scene
A large mixed salad with chickpeas, dark lentils, browned tofu-like cubes, leafy greens, chopped vegetables and a few black olives.

### Step 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **27 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 573 cm².**
The plate at the left edge is excluded.

### Step 3 — Visible items
- Cooked dark lentils
- Chickpeas
- Browned cubes, most likely tofu rather than cheese
- Mixed leafy greens
- Cucumber, carrot, red onion and small tomato/pepper pieces
- Black olives
- A light glossy coating, estimated as a little oil-based dressing; its quantity is uncertain

### Steps 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Areas are allocated between ingredients rather than counting overlapping ingredients twice. Heights describe each ingredient’s pile envelope.

| Item | Plate area | Area, cm² | Height, cm | Gross volume, ml | Density, g/ml | Weight, g | kcal/100 g | Energy, kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked lentils | 16% | 91.7 | 1.6 | 147 | 0.80 | 117 | 116 | 136 |
| Chickpeas | 14% | 80.2 | 1.5 | 120 | 0.70 | 84 | 164 | 138 |
| Tofu cubes | 12% | 68.8 | 1.7 | 117 | 0.95 | 111 | 150 | 167 |
| Leafy greens | 25% | 143.3 | 2.8 | 401 | 0.15 | 60 | 20 | 12 |
| Mixed cut vegetables | 16% | 91.7 | 1.6 | 147 | 0.60 | 88 | 25 | 22 |
| Black olives | 3% | 17.2 | 1.0 | 17 | 0.65 | 11 | 116 | 13 |
| Oil-based coating | Overlay¹ | — | — | ~4 | ~1.0 | 4 | 884 | 35 |

¹The thin coating adds no separate footprint. **Food coverage totals 86%**, consistent with the mostly covered plate.

### Step 8 — Sanity check
**Estimated total: 575 g and approximately 520 kcal.** This is plausible for a substantial salad covering most of a dinner plate. The main uncertainties are the plate size, dressing quantity and whether the cubes are tofu or cheese.
